meta.title: Scanned pages to Markdown
meta.description: Turn scanned book pages or photos into Markdown. A cloud OCR model reads each page; the plugin orders pages by their printed folios, strips running heads, rebuilds tables, and writes every original page image beside the text so the folder imports straight into Obsidian.

panel.title: Scanned pages to Markdown
panel.hint: Pages are ordered, running heads removed, tables rebuilt, and images written next to the Markdown
panel.bookTitle: Book title (used as the top heading)
panel.noKey: No API key yet: set it in plugin settings or export OCR_SCAN_API_KEY
